# Trajectory  
[⌂ HOME](/d/dpp-home) · [SALES](/d/dpp-sales) · [CATALOG](/d/dpp-catalog) · ADS · [INVENTORY](/d/dpp-inventory) · FINANCE · **TRAJECTORY** · [DATA HEALTH](/d/dpp-data-health)  
*The question here is structural: is the business getting stronger, or only having a good week?*

targets.rawSql: SELECT sales_t28 AS value FROM mart.business_rolling WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date=CURRENT_DATE;

WITH x AS (SELECT business_date,sales_t28 FROM mart.business_rolling WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date IN (CURRENT_DATE,CURRENT_DATE-28)) SELECT 100.0*(max(sales_t28) FILTER(WHERE business_date=CURRENT_DATE)-max(sales_t28) FILTER(WHERE business_date=CURRENT_DATE-28))/NULLIF(max(sales_t28) FILTER(WHERE business_date=CURRENT_DATE-28),0) AS value FROM x;
SELECT sales_t56 AS value FROM mart.business_rolling WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date=CURRENT_DATE;
SELECT COALESCE(sum(sessions),0) AS value FROM core.sales_traffic_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE-28 AND CURRENT_DATE-1;
SELECT 100.0*sum(units_ordered)/NULLIF(sum(sessions),0) AS value FROM core.sales_traffic_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE-28 AND CURRENT_DATE-1;
SELECT count(DISTINCT seller_sku)::int AS value FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27 AND units>0;

WITH s AS (SELECT seller_sku,sum(sales) v FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27 GROUP BY seller_sku),r AS (SELECT v,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY v DESC) rn FROM s) SELECT 100.0*sum(v) FILTER(WHERE rn<=3)/NULLIF(sum(v),0) AS value FROM r;
SELECT business_date::timestamp AS time,sales_t28 AS value,'T28' AS metric FROM mart.business_rolling WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-179 ORDER BY business_date;
SELECT business_date::timestamp AS time,sales_t56 AS value,'T56' AS metric FROM mart.business_rolling WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-179 ORDER BY business_date;

SELECT business_date::timestamp AS time,avg(sessions) OVER(ORDER BY business_date ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value FROM core.sales_traffic_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-179 ORDER BY business_date;

SELECT business_date::timestamp AS time,100.0*sum(units_ordered) OVER(ORDER BY business_date ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)/NULLIF(sum(sessions) OVER(ORDER BY business_date ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),0) AS value FROM core.sales_traffic_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-179 ORDER BY business_date;

WITH days AS (SELECT generate_series(GREATEST((SELECT min(business_date) FROM mart.sku_daily),CURRENT_DATE-179),CURRENT_DATE,'1 day')::date d) SELECT d::timestamp AS time,(SELECT count(DISTINCT seller_sku) FROM mart.sku_daily s WHERE s.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND s.business_date BETWEEN days.d-27 AND days.d AND s.units>0) AS value FROM days ORDER BY d;

WITH f AS (SELECT seller_sku,min(business_date) first_sale FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' GROUP BY seller_sku),x AS (SELECT d.business_date,sum(d.sales) FILTER(WHERE d.business_date-f.first_sale<56) new_sales,sum(d.sales) FILTER(WHERE d.business_date-f.first_sale>=56) mature_sales FROM mart.sku_daily d JOIN f USING(seller_sku) WHERE d.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND d.business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-179 GROUP BY d.business_date) SELECT business_date::timestamp AS time,COALESCE(new_sales,0) AS value,'New (<56d)' AS metric FROM x UNION ALL SELECT business_date::timestamp,COALESCE(mature_sales,0),'Mature' FROM x ORDER BY time,metric;
